description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods, with the categories listed on the horizontal axis in the order: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTuneCInGS, CInGS (w/), and CInGS. The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each method is represented by a distinct colored bar: Standard is orange with a value of approximately 52, Self-RAG is beige with a value of around 53.5, FactTuneCInGS is green with a value of about 51, CInGS (w/) is blue with a value of roughly 54, and CInGS is dark blue with a value of approximately 59. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and they are arranged in a specific order along the horizontal axis, with no apparent sorting by height or alphabetical order beyond the given sequence. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors.
